name: Camping 101: Tailoring

angles.text: Tailors can weave an inspirational Faction Banner to bolster morale and keep spirits energized at camp during long expeditions.
Alliance adventurers are directed toward Eldrin at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest to learn faction banner stitching.

faq.answer: Camping 101: Tailoring directs aspiring tailors to seek out Eldrin at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. Once a tailor demonstrates sufficient proficiency, Eldrin instructs them in how to stitch an inspirational Faction Banner to raise spirits at a campsite.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Camping 101: Tailoring?

faq.answer: Eldrin is an artisan residing at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. He possesses the expertise to instruct skilled tailors in crafting camp-ready faction banners.
faq.q: Who is Eldrin and where can he be found?

aliases: what does the tailoring banner do
faq.answer: The Faction Banner serves as a campsite centerpiece designed to foster morale and inspiration. In the field, displaying your allegiance helps keep weary travelers energized and focused during grueling campaigns.
faq.q: What does the Faction Banner do for a camp?

aliases: can any tailor make a banner
faq.answer: The craft requires demonstrated proficiency in tailoring before Eldrin will share the technique. Only practitioners who have honed their needlework can properly weave and assemble the banner.
faq.q: What requirements are needed to learn the craft from Eldrin?

faq.answer: The Eastvale Logging Camp is nestled in the eastern woods of Elwynn Forest, situated along the road leading toward Redridge Mountains. It is an active logging hub where local craftspeople and workers gather.
faq.q: Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp located?

faq.answer: This particular errand sends the artisan to Eldrin in the heart of Elwynn Forest, firmly within Alliance territory. As such, it caters to Alliance-aligned craftsmen operating out of the eastern settlements.
faq.q: Is this task exclusive to Alliance tailors?

sections.body: Camping 101: Tailoring directs promising needleworkers to Eldrin, an artisan based at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. Tailoring is often celebrated for producing protective cloth garments and bags, but this assignment highlights its role in sustaining wilderness ventures. Adventurers who have proven their aptitude with thread and loom are offered specialized guidance in fashioning camp accessories that support sustained travel across the wilderness.
sections.title: A Weaver's Purpose in the Wild

sections.body: The primary craft taught through this guidance is the Faction Banner, an emblem designed to stand tall beside a traveler's fire. On dangerous journeys and battlegrounds alike, maintaining high morale is just as essential as maintaining weapons or rations. Displaying an inspiring banner over an encampment offers weary adventurers a familiar symbol of resolve, providing the energetic lift needed to press forward into hostile lands.
sections.title: Banners of Morale

summary: Camping 101: Tailoring points skilled clothworkers toward Eldrin at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. Through him, tailors learn to weave a Faction Banner that provides inspiration and raises morale at backcountry campsites.
